body:
Who you want to address the question (Can be addressed by a whole group or one specific Senior Staff member); all
Question; Can you make mods do a training course as the server is now getting stupid. People aren't getting told off for caps, spam, flood, rudeness, bullying etc by some mods. This is ruining peoples experience and also it is a while before mods ban someone for hacking.

title: Can you make mods do a training course?

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Mods receive training during their Jr mod trial. We're also actually in the process of redoing the trial and training process, so there very well could be some improvements.

If you are noticing any moderators not doing their jobs and ignoring reports / issues going on on the server, please contact any of the Senior staff, or email support@avicus.net.

Hopefully with the next staff applications, we'll get people from time zones where we have little amounts of moderators. If we do, this will mean that we won't struggle as much to have moderators on during those times of the day where there's less staff online.
